transcript.content: Hello, please have a seat. What brings you in to see me today?

Thanks. Well, I came in because for the last few weeks I've barely had an appetite. It's just... gone, I guess. Even the food I usually like to grab after a long shift, it just sits there in front of me. I basically have to force myself to choke down a few bites. I figured I should probably talk to someone about it.
Along with this change in your appetite, how has your mood been over these past few weeks?

Honestly, it hasn't been great. Most days I feel like I’m just carrying this heavy, flat feeling around with me. It’s like... even when I’m home with my family, or just sitting in the break room at work, I’m just not really there.
Have you ever experienced periods where you felt unusually energetic, wired, or on top of the world for days at a time?

No, I can't say I have. I mean, I've had good days here and there, sure, but nothing like what you're describing. Never felt wired or like I was on top of the world. Just... normal, I guess. At least until recently.
Did anything specific happen in your life, such as a major change or stressful event, around the time these symptoms started?

Yeah, actually. This has been going on for about three weeks now. Right around then, the casino I work at reorganized our whole security operation. They changed up my assignments and, I don't know, things just haven't felt right since then.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you normally enjoy doing?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to my morning runs, playing my guitar, or even just cooking dinner. But lately, I just keep skipping them. It's like... they just feel like chores now, and I can't really get myself to care about doing them anymore.
How has your sleep been over these past few weeks?

My sleep? Um, it's been pretty normal, actually. I haven't really noticed any changes there. I'm still getting my usual, you know, seven or eight hours a night. So, yeah, no real issues with the sleeping part of things.
How have your energy levels been over these past few weeks?

My energy levels? Um, they've been fine, really. I haven't noticed feeling particularly tired or drained or anything like that. I just... I still have my normal amount of energy, I guess. It's just the other stuff I mentioned.
Have you noticed any trouble with your concentration or making everyday decisions lately?

Yeah, actually, I have. It's been happening at work. I'm a security guard, so I spend a lot of time watching CCTV feeds and writing up incident reports. But lately, my mind just drifts. I'll realize I haven't been paying attention to the screens, or I have to reread my reports over and over because I can't focus. It's frustrating because I've ended up making a few mistakes that I normally wouldn't make. It's just hard to keep my head in it right now.
Have you been feeling down on yourself, or experiencing strong feelings of guilt or worthlessness lately?

No, I wouldn't say that. I mean, I get a little frustrated with myself when I make those mistakes at work, but... no, I don't feel worthless or guilty. I'm not really beating myself up over things, so I haven't noticed anything like what you're describing.
Have you had any thoughts of death, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

No, I'm not planning to hurt myself or anything like that. But, well, I do keep having these thoughts lately. Just... thinking that maybe it wouldn't be the worst thing if I went to sleep and just didn't wake up. It kind of feels like it would be easier than having to keep pushing through all of this every day.
